chunks: How can God show the way to those who, having come to faith, turned away, even though they had borne witness that the Messenger was true, and the clear signs had reached them? God does not show the unrighteous the way.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'How can God guide a people who disbelieved after their faith'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Banu al-Sawd'a or specifically to Ali ibn Abi Talib, who temporarily concealed his faith (Taqiyyah) during the Meccan period before openly declaring it, thus illustrating that divine guidance is withheld from those who persist in injustice after clear proof. It underscores the principle that mere initial belief is insufficient if not accompanied by steadfastness and sincerity, a key theme in understanding the status of the Ahl al-Bayt. The verse serves as a warning against the spiritual stagnation of those who, despite witnessing miracles, choose to remain in their self-imposed darkness.
